name: Queensland Electricity Rebate
summary: Yearly rebate on your home electricity bill for Queenslanders holding an eligible concession card, including the Health Care Card.
key: Eligible households can receive $386.34 per year (2025–26 rate).
who: Queensland resident holding an eligible card, including a Health Care Card issued by Services Australia
how: Contact your electricity retailer – their number is on your electricity bill.
catches: The factsheet states amounts for the 2025–26 financial year; the 2026–27 figure may differ.

evidence.claim: Health Care Card is an eligible card
evidence.quote: Health Care Card issued by Services Australia.
